controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.ssh-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-18T07:17:07.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T08:17:07.500Z"
| WHERE source.ip == "172.18.0.15" OR destination.ip == "172.18.0.15"
| STATS events = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY source.ip, destination.ip, zeek.ssh.client, zeek.ssh.server
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 1000
